# One seed per configuration: cells are labelled n=1, differences are
# bare points with no interval or test, and nothing is marked significant.

exec trainstat -skip 1 -filter seed:1 $TESTDATA/sweep/base.txt $TESTDATA/sweep/new.txt
stdout '^replicates: seed \(1\)$'
stdout '^runs: 2 done, 0 stopped$'
stdout '│  n=1     │  n=1     Δ'
stdout '^Final/split=val +0\.8010 +0\.8060  \+0\.0050 +n=1$'
stdout '^Final/split=val +0\.02100 +0\.02000  -0\.00100 +n=1$'
! stdout 'CI of Δ'
! stdout 'p='
! stdout 'comparisons differ'

# Without a replicate key, results with equal configuration must be
# identical; two that differ are not reproducible.
exec trainstat a.txt b.txt
stdout '^replicates: none \(no seed\)'
stdout '^Final +0\.5000 +not reproducible$'
stdout '^note: Final loss b\.txt: results differ: 0\.5 and 0\.25$'

-- a.txt --
BenchmarkFinal 1 0.5 loss
-- b.txt --
BenchmarkFinal 1 0.5 loss
BenchmarkFinal 1 0.25 loss
